summary: Short kerb by a car park; a residential block sits 16 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Car park to the south and east, but a residential building 16 m away on the same side and houses across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Only 10 m of kerb, just over a van length; cars already park in line.
drivers.traffic: Side street near a main road; light to moderate traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars parked along the kerb; sign is 2P weekdays, resident permits excepted.

flags: Steep: about 9% grade, 14% at its steepest
sun_shade: Large tree on the east side shades the kerb in the afternoon.

best_section.where: East kerb of Harrys Road, beside the retail car park entrance
